narrative.overview:
A calm, warm operational workbench for officers who decide one invoice at a time. Oat ground, warm-white panels and navy ink carry nearly everything; colour is spent on meaning. Lava belongs to the primary action and to focus; warn amber is the colour of evidence, outlining the cited region on the rendered page and tinting the field row it belongs to.

The world is pinned by the Genie Design export and carried into an AppKit React app: a 248px sidebar and 72px blurred top bar, panels on hairline borders with one soft raised shadow, DM Sans throughout and the system mono for every figure compared down a column. Motion is state only, 150-200ms on one standard ease.
keyCharacteristics: Oat ground, warm-white panels, navy ink; active nav and filter invert to navy.
Lava (#C42A18 under text) only for the primary action, checked decision controls, caret and focus.
Warn amber is the evidence colour: page highlight, held tint, held tag.
Mono with tabular figures for money, ids, confidence, days left and summary values.
12px controls, 16px panels, pills for filters, tags and the OFFICIAL classification.
One raised shadow at rest; overlay only for things floating above scrolling content.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Lava marks the action that moves the decision forward and the element that has focus. A second lava element on a screen is a defect unless it is a checked control inside that same decision.

rules.name: The Amber Is Evidence Rule
rules.body: Warn amber means "look here on the page": the cited region, the held field, the held tag. It is not a generic warning colour and never carries text at full strength; use warn ink.

rules.name: The Deepened Lava Rule
rules.body: Text never sits on #FF3621. Where lava is a fill under text, use #C42A18.

rules.name: The Figures In Mono Rule
rules.body: Money, document ids, confidence and day counts are always set in the mono with tabular numerals. Prose numbers stay in DM Sans.

rules.name: The Label Is Not A Kicker Rule
rules.body: Uppercase mono is reserved for column heads and group labels inside a list or the nav. It never sits above a page or panel heading; context above an H1 belongs in the crumb.

rules.name: The Float Earns Overlay Rule
rules.body: The overlay shadow is for elements that sit above content scrolling beneath them. Anything in the flow of the page uses raised or nothing.

dos: Do keep lava to the primary action, the checked control in the decision form, and focus; use #C42A18 wherever text sits on it.
Do use warn amber for evidence: the page highlight, the held tint, the held tag; use warn ink when it must be read as text.
Do set money, ids, confidence and days left in the mono with tabular figures.
Do give every score its reason, and show confidence beside the clock rather than in place of it; queues order by days left.
Do use raised for cards at rest and overlay only for the floating dock, dialog and toast.
Do use one drawn icon system (lucide) at one stroke weight, sized 12 to 22px per context.
Do keep motion to state changes at 150ms or 200ms and honour reduced motion.
donts: Don't put an uppercase label above a page or panel heading; the crumb carries context.
Don't use warn amber at full strength as a text colour, or as a general-purpose warning fill.
Don't add a second accent or a bulk-approve action; acceptance is per invoice and locked behind held fields.
Don't let AppKit components fall back to their shadcn defaults or the OS colour scheme; map them to the palette.
Don't use Unicode glyphs as icons.
